nodes.description: When `parse_regex` handles the witness's only explicit `(`, it either increments `cb->bracount` once or emits `META_NOCAPTURE` depending on `PCRE2_NO_AUTO_CAPTURE`. This is the first project-code site that materializes the small capture-count state later stored in `re->top_bracket`.

The result-copy length is derived only from the external `oveccount`, so the harness-fixed 32-pair ovector makes `match()` copy 31 capture pairs before it consults `top_bracket + 1`. For this witness the crashing compiled pattern has `top_bracket <= 1`, so the internal frame provides at most one capture pair and the copy over-reads it. The fix first clamps with `min(top_bracket + 1, oveccount)` before calling `memcpy`.

ASan crash site. This `memcpy` reads the recorded 496 bytes from the current frame's internal `Fovector` even though the crashing compiled pattern from this witness can expose at most one captured-group pair there, so the read runs off the stack-resident `stack_frames_vector`.
